column1: QMC-104,"qmc_core.codec, aggregate, replay: hex floats, fsum aggregation, finalize decision, replay compare",ws0,early,5,M0,QMC-100,yes,core,"HANDOFF §6.1, §7.4, §7.7, §5.4. `codec`: float↔hex, params↔repr strings, NS↔set. `aggregate(shards) -> Result` (index order, fsum, Bessel variance, SE, 1.959963984540054 CI, hex). `decide(job_item, now) -> Finalize | Reap | Nothing` (pure: counts done/failed/missing, deadline). `replay.compare(original_shards, replay_shards) -> ReplayCheck` (per-shard hex diffs, fingerprint diffs excluding cpu_model). `aggregate` handles N = 0 (null result) and N = 1 (null SE/CI). `decide()` returns the done-count snapshot that `finalize_partial` conditions on.
**Acceptance:** Hex round-trip exact for 100k random doubles incl. subnormals and ±0
column2: aggregation is order-independent at the bit level (shuffle test) and matches a straightforward float64 reference within 1e-12 relative
column3: decide() covers complete, partial, reaped, not-yet, already-terminal
column4: compare() flags a 1-ULP change in one shard. aggregate() with 0 and 1 samples never divides by zero
column5: decide() covers 0 done shards."
